answer: A graded epoch keeps a public beacon of median jury scores per submitter; attestation weight decays when a peer’s last three grades diverge more than one band from that beacon. Sybils still flood zephyr-cheap empty templates, but each new key must buy prism-shaped stake equal to the median spend of the prior cohort before its votes count — so the 1000th sock costs as much as the first, and grader minutes stay aimed at mechanisms with named cost curves rather than vignettes.
